requiredEvidence: An explicit dataset licence identifier or licence text from the authoritative Zenodo record or depositor is captured.
The captured terms permit the intended automated ingestion and aggregate profiling use.
The exact release/version and file manifest are pinned before retrieval.

profilingPlanAfterRightsClearance: Retrieve the version-pinned file manifest and record hashes/checksums without committing raw third-party data.
Enumerate delivered cycle IDs from file names and internal metadata rather than assuming the currently visible cycle_001 examples are the complete release.
Profile machine, pressure/temperature, ultrasonic and DEA tables separately while preserving their source-defined time bases and units.
Establish synchronization keys and time alignment across modalities before any cross-sensor sample count is accepted.
Separate directly measured channels from setpoints, commands, derived features, RMS summaries and process metadata.
Count measured time-series values only from delivered measured arrays/columns with ordering and measurement semantics established.
Emit aggregate schemas, counts and fingerprints only; do not upload raw rows, arrays or cell values as workflow artifacts.
evidenceBoundary: The official Zenodo API confirms CC BY 4.0 and the three visible files were retrieved and SHA-256 fingerprinted. The source counts as one profiled real dataset family. It contributes zero values to the accepted cross-dataset time-series total because the visible release contains only cycle_001 and several delivered channel units are not explicit.
